scope: 14 independent risk representatives cover15 affected tests; normal conftest; no syntactic checklist.

mutations.name: visual-default
mutations.risk: Visual default/consumer must use receipt-bound policy; text override and opt-out assertions retained.

mutations.name: ensemble-members
mutations.old: for name in dict.fromkeys(part.strip() for part in provider_id.split(",")):
mutations.new: for name in list(dict.fromkeys(part.strip() for part in provider_id.split(",")))[:1]:
mutations.risk: Every requested independent ensemble member survives ordered resolution; not a fallback list.

mutations.name: receipt-integrity
mutations.old: if not valid or result.model in capabilities:
mutations.risk: Actual matched answers/model/prompt/physical proof; forged or duplicate records cannot certify.

mutations.name: privacy-stop
mutations.risk: Activating verified Gemini must not turn privacy refusal into fallback; guarded chain unchanged.

mutations.name: global-budget-stop
mutations.risk: Global exhaustion is terminal, independently of eligible availability fallback.

mutations.name: exact-legacy-only
mutations.risk: Custom/partial settings and evidence never become migration candidates.

mutations.name: selected-only
mutations.old: return [_change_one(root, entries[slug], restore) for slug in dict.fromkeys(selected)]
mutations.new: return [_change_one(root, entries[slug], restore) for slug in entries]
mutations.risk: Explicit project selection must bound all writes; idempotent/reversal assertions retained.

mutations.name: byte-envelope
mutations.risk: Only provider span may change; outside Unicode/newline/evidence bytes preserved.

mutations.name: approved-target
mutations.risk: An edited plan cannot migrate custom source or inject arbitrary provider target; stale snapshots also retain independent digest guards.

mutations.name: backup-integrity
mutations.risk: Restoration must validate original bytes and approved transformation, never trust a backup filename.

mutations.name: root-binding
mutations.old: if str(root.resolve()) != plan.root or type(restore) is not bool:
mutations.risk: A plan cannot be replayed against another project root; path/JSON/selection ambiguity assertions retained.

mutations.name: atomic-byte-mode
mutations.old: mode, options = ("wb", {}) if isinstance(text, bytes) else ("w", {"encoding": "utf-8"})
mutations.risk: New byte primitive preserves exact snapshots; old text translation/cleanup assertions retained.

mutations.name: dryrun-default
mutations.risk: CLI dryrun cannot execute apply/restore without explicit mode and selected project.

mutations.name: observable-default
mutations.risk: Empty/default substitution remains observable independently from explicit custom/default choices.
